2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-my-progression-inputs and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Takes the training plan feed (the plan, its stored progression rules and, when there is one, the last session's result with its measured signals).
